sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心，竭力隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查出了她的名字——艾达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是罪案档案推介（Casefile Presents）的全新系列播客，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: On Friday, February 6, 1981, married couple Brian and Beverly Barry left their home in the Wollongong suburb of Mount Pleasant.
sentences.zh: 1981年2月6日，星期五，已婚夫妇布莱恩·巴里（Brian Barry）和贝弗利·巴里（Beverly Barry）离开了他们在卧龙岗普莱桑特山郊区的家。

sentences.en: They were headed north on a six-and-a-half-hour drive to their holiday home in the coastal New South Wales town of Sawtell.
sentences.zh: 他们向北驱车六个半小时，前往位于新南威尔士州沿海小镇绍特尔（Sawtell）的度假屋。

sentences.en: They weren't planning to stay away for long.
sentences.zh: 他们并不打算离开太久。

sentences.en: Brian and Beverly had received a letter from the local council in Sawtell informing them that their property's lawn was overgrown and they risked receiving a fine.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩和贝弗利收到了绍特尔当地议会的一封信，通知他们物业的草坪长得太高，可能会面临罚款。

sentences.en: So, the couple had decided to go up for a quick, overnight visit to tidy the yard.
sentences.zh: 因此，夫妻俩决定上去进行一次短暂的隔夜访问，修剪一下院子。

sentences.en: Usually, Brian and Beverly's children would accompany them on trips to the holiday house, but not this time.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，布莱恩和贝弗利的孩子们会陪同他们一起去度假屋，但这次没有。

sentences.en: Their son, Wayne, who was 15, was preparing for an athletics competition and had a training session to attend.
sentences.zh: 他们的儿子韦恩（Wayne）当时15岁，正在为一场田径比赛做准备，有一场训练要参加。

sentences.en: The couple's eldest child, 19-year-old Kim, worked at a local supermarket and had a shift she couldn't get out of.
sentences.zh: 夫妻俩的长子、19岁的金（Kim）在当地一家超市工作，有一个无法推脱的班要上。

sentences.en: While Brian and Beverly were away, Kim would be in charge and responsible for looking after her little brother.
sentences.zh: 在布莱恩和贝弗利不在期间，金将负责掌管家务并照顾她的小弟弟。

sentences.en: After arriving at the Sawtell property later that day, Brian and Beverly Barry set about gardening and mowing the long grass.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候到达绍特尔的房产后，布莱恩和贝弗利·巴里开始整理园艺并修剪长草。

sentences.en: The physical labour left the couple tired and when they went to bed that night, Brian fell asleep quickly.
sentences.zh: 体力劳动让夫妻俩精疲力竭，当晚他们上床睡觉时，布莱恩很快就睡着了。

sentences.en: Initially, Beverly slept well too.
sentences.zh: 起初，贝弗利也睡得很好。

sentences.en: But in the middle of the night, she was suddenly woken by the sound of someone calling out to her.
sentences.zh: 但在半夜，她突然被一阵呼唤她的声音惊醒。

sentences.en: Beverly recognised the voice right away.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利一下子就听出了这个声音。

sentences.en: It belonged to her daughter, Kim.
sentences.zh: 那是属于她女儿金的声音。

sentences.en: Half asleep, Beverly sat up and looked towards the bedroom door.
sentences.zh: 迷迷糊糊中，贝弗利坐起身，朝卧室门看去。

sentences.en: She expected to see Kim standing there, only to realise a split second later that wasn't possible.
sentences.zh: 她本期望看到金站在那里，但在零点几秒后才意识到这不可能。

sentences.en: Beverly wasn't at home.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利不在家。

sentences.en: She was more than 600 kilometres away and Kim was back in Mount Pleasant.
sentences.zh: 她远在600多公里之外，而金还在普莱桑特山。

sentences.en: Telling herself that she must have been dreaming, Beverly lay down again to go back to sleep, the sound of her daughter's voice fading from her mind.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利告诉自己一定是在做梦，于是又躺下继续睡觉，女儿的声音从她的脑海中渐渐淡去。

sentences.en: The Barry's quick visit to Sawtell had paid off.
sentences.zh: 巴里夫妇对绍特尔的快闪之行得到了回报。

sentences.en: They left the property early the following morning, arriving back in Mount Pleasant at around 3pm.
sentences.zh: 第二天一大早他们就离开了那处房产，大约下午3点回到了普莱桑特山。

sentences.en: As Brian and Beverly walked through the front door, they were surprised to find their son, Wayne, at home by himself.
sentences.zh: 当布莱恩和贝弗利走进前门时，惊讶地发现他们的儿子韦恩独自在家。

sentences.en: Wayne said he didn't know where his sister was.
sentences.zh: 韦恩说他不知道姐姐在哪里。

sentences.en: He'd returned after athletics training the previous afternoon to find Kim making dinner for them both.
sentences.zh: 他昨天下午参加完田径训练回来，发现金正在为他俩做晚饭。

sentences.en: She'd explained that she was meeting a friend that night, but Wayne couldn't remember who.
sentences.zh: 她解释说她那天晚上要和一个朋友见面，但韦恩记不清是谁了。

sentences.en: After the siblings finished eating, Kim tidied up the dishes, then went outside to call a taxi from a payphone in the street.
sentences.zh: 姐弟俩吃完饭后，金收拾了碗盘，然后出门去街上的公用电话亭打电话。

sentences.en: The Barry's didn't have a landline at home and were reliant on the public payphone that sat about 150 metres from their house.
sentences.zh: 巴里家里没有座机，全靠距离他们家大约150米的公共电话亭。

sentences.en: After Kim left that evening, Wayne hadn't seen her again.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上金离开后，韦恩就再也没有见过她。

sentences.en: Kim had been in trouble once before for staying out all night without warning.
sentences.zh: 金以前曾因为没有事先警告就在外面过夜而惹过麻烦。

sentences.en: Ever since then, she'd always left a note explaining if she planned to stay with a friend.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，如果她计划在朋友家过夜，她总是会留下一张字条说明。

sentences.en: But this time, she hadn't left anything for her parents to surmise where she might be.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，她什么也没留下，让父母无从猜测她可能会去哪里。

sentences.en: Brian Barry wasn't concerned.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩·巴里并不担心。

sentences.en: He suspected Kim had gotten caught up having fun with friends and would be home soon enough.
sentences.zh: 他猜想金是被朋友们拉着玩得开心，很快就会回家了。

sentences.en: Beverly felt a hint of worry.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利感到一丝担忧。

sentences.en: She couldn't help but feel that something must be wrong.
sentences.zh: 她总觉得有什么不对劲。

sentences.en: She headed out to the payphone and started calling Kim's friends, asking if they'd seen her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她走到电话亭，开始给金的朋友们打电话，询问他们是否见过她的女儿。

sentences.en: Nobody she spoke to had seen Kim or had any idea where she might be.
sentences.zh: 她所交谈的人中没有一个见过金，也不知道她会在哪里。

sentences.en: The Barrys expected Kim to reappear later that afternoon or into the evening, but she didn't.
sentences.zh: 巴里夫妇原本期望金能在那天下午晚些时候或傍晚回来，但她没有。

sentences.en: Brian remained confident that 19-year-old Kim would be home by the time the weekend ended, but Beverly's concern was growing.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩依然坚信19岁的金会在周末结束前回家，但贝弗利的担忧却在与日俱增。

sentences.en: She tossed and turned that night, unable to sleep.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上她在床上辗转反侧，无法入睡。

sentences.en: Sunday, February 8 passed, with no word from Kim.
sentences.zh: 2月8日星期日过去了，依然没有金的任何消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, Brian and Beverly Barry headed off to their respective jobs.
sentences.zh: 周一，布莱恩和贝弗利·巴里各自去上班。

sentences.en: Later that morning, a call came through at the manufacturing firm where Beverly worked as a clerk.
sentences.zh: 那天上午晚些时候，贝弗利担任文员的那家制造公司打来了一个电话。

sentences.en: It was a friend of her daughter's named Donna Holland.
sentences.zh: 打电话的是她女儿的一个朋友，名叫唐娜·霍兰德（Donna Holland）。

sentences.en: Despite Kim and Donna only having known each other for a few months, the two were already close.
sentences.zh: 尽管金和唐娜只认识了几个月，但两人的关系已经很亲密了。

sentences.en: Beverly had wanted to get in touch with Donna over the weekend to ask if she knew where Kim was, but she didn't have her number.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利本想在周末联系唐娜，问她是否知道金在哪里，但她没有唐娜的电话号码。

sentences.en: Now, Donna was able to provide Beverly with key information regarding the Friday night Kim left home and didn't return.
sentences.zh: 现在，唐娜能够向贝弗利提供关于金离开家且未归的那个周五晚上的关键信息。

sentences.en: That evening, 17-year-old Donna Holland had felt like she was coming down with the flu.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，17岁的唐娜·霍兰德觉得有点像要患上流感。

sentences.en: She wasn't up for a big night, but she'd already made plans to see a movie with Kim Barry and felt she couldn't cancel.
sentences.zh: 她本来不打算大晚上出门狂欢，但她已经和金·巴里约好去看电影，觉得自己无法取消。

sentences.en: Kim, who was two years older than Donna, had called the day before, eager to catch up.
sentences.zh: 比唐娜大两岁的金在前一天就打了电话，迫不及待地想要叙叙旧。

sentences.en: Donna caught a bus to the Crown Central shopping complex in Wollongong where the girls had arranged to meet.
sentences.zh: 唐娜乘公交车来到卧龙岗的皇冠中心（Crown Central）购物综合体，两人约好在那里碰头。

sentences.en: Kim was travelling there by taxi.
sentences.zh: 金则是坐出租车过去的。

sentences.en: After meeting up at around 7.30pm, the friends grabbed a quick drink, then caught a 7.45 screening of the comedy film Flying High.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点半左右碰头后，朋友俩先喝了杯饮料，然后赶着去看7点45分放映的喜剧电影《空前绝后满天飞》（Flying High）。

sentences.en: It was just after 10 when the movie ended and Donna was keen to go home.
sentences.zh: 电影散场时刚过10点，唐娜急着想回家。

sentences.en: As well as feeling slightly unwell, she had an early start the following morning at a babysitting job.
sentences.zh: 除了感觉身体有些不舒服外，她第二天一早还要去当保姆。

sentences.en: But Kim persuaded Donna to accompany her to a local nightclub for a dance.
sentences.zh: 但金说服唐娜陪她去当地的一家夜总会跳舞。

sentences.en: Kim loved dancing and even took lessons.
sentences.zh: 金很喜欢跳舞，甚至还上过舞蹈课。

sentences.en: The pair walked to the nearby Crown Gardens Disco, stopping at a pharmacy to buy Band-Aids along the way.
sentences.zh: 两人步行前往附近的皇冠花园迪斯科舞厅（Crown Gardens Disco），途中在一家药店停下来买创可贴。

sentences.en: Kim said her shoes were hurting her feet and put one Band-Aid on each heel before continuing on.
sentences.zh: 金说她的鞋子磨脚，每只脚后跟贴了一个创可贴才继续前行。

sentences.en: When they arrived at the disco, one of the bouncers asked Kim to save a dance for him later.
sentences.zh: 当她们到达迪斯科舞厅时，一个保镖让金一会儿留支舞给他。

sentences.en: She agreed.
sentences.zh: 她答应了。

sentences.en: Inside, the venue was packed.
sentences.zh: 舞厅里面人山人海。

sentences.en: The girls had to navigate through a big crowd in order to find seats.
sentences.zh: 女孩们不得不穿过密集的人群才能找到座位。

sentences.en: Kim bought drinks for herself and Donna.
sentences.zh: 金给自己和唐娜买了几杯饮料。

sentences.en: The underage Donna had a lemonade, while Kim chose the coffee liqueur Tia Maria.
sentences.zh: 未成年的唐娜喝的是柠檬水，而金则选择了添万利（Tia Maria）咖啡利口酒。

sentences.en: Kim proposed that they toast to something, then held up her glass and stated,
sentences.zh: 金提议说她们为某事干杯，接着她举起杯子说道：

sentences.en: May I soon get a steady boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 愿我能早日找到一个稳定的男朋友。

sentences.en: The girls clinked glasses, then sat drinking and chatting for a little while.
sentences.zh: 女孩们碰了碰杯子，随后坐下来一边喝酒一边闲聊了一会儿。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Kim asked Donna if she would like to stay over at her place that night.
sentences.zh: 突然，金问唐娜今晚愿不愿意在她家过夜。

sentences.en: Kim's parents were away and she said she was scared as there'd been a prowler lurking around her neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 金的父母不在家，她说自己很害怕，因为附近一直有个潜行者在周围徘徊。

sentences.en: Donna said she couldn't.
sentences.zh: 唐娜说她不能。

sentences.en: She had to get up at 5am for her babysitting job and needed to leave soon.
sentences.zh: 她早上5点钟就得起床去做保姆，必须早点离开。

sentences.en: She planned to catch a train home and had already arranged for her mother to pick her up from the station.
sentences.zh: 她打算坐火车回家，并且已经安排好由她母亲去车站接她。

sentences.en: Kim continued to beg Donna to stay.
sentences.zh: 金继续哀求唐娜留下来。

sentences.en: She seemed desperate not to be left alone.
sentences.zh: 她似乎极其不愿独自留在家中。

sentences.en: She suggested Donna stay until the nightclub closed at 3am and even offered to pay for Donna's taxi home.
sentences.zh: 她建议唐娜留到夜总会凌晨3点关门，甚至主动提出为唐娜的出租车费买单。

sentences.en: But Donna stood firm.
sentences.zh: 但唐娜态度坚决。

sentences.en: It was nearly midnight and she had to go.
sentences.zh: 已经快午夜了，她必须得走了。

sentences.en: Besides, she was certain that there was no prowler and Kim was just making up excuses so Donna would stay.
sentences.zh: 再说了，她确信根本没有什么潜行者，金只是在找借口让唐娜留下来而已。

sentences.en: Before leaving, Donna lent Kim some money so she could buy a bottle of wine and checked that her friend had enough cash to get home.
sentences.zh: 离开前，唐娜借给金一些钱让她可以买瓶酒，并确认她的朋友有足够的现金回家。

sentences.en: As she left, Donna said to Kim,
sentences.zh: 临走时，唐娜对金说：

sentences.en: Be careful and catch a taxi home.
sentences.zh: 小心点，坐出租车回家。

sentences.en: Give me a ring tomorrow afternoon.
sentences.zh: 明天下午给我打个电话。

sentences.en: Donna thought this was a little odd as the two spoke regularly and had talked about maybe catching up again over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 唐娜觉得这有点奇怪，因为两人经常通电话，而且还谈过可能在周末再次聚聚的事。

sentences.en: Two days later, on Monday morning, Donna Holland was listening to the radio when a news broadcast caught her attention.
sentences.zh: 两天后的星期一早上，唐娜·霍兰德正在听收音机，一则新闻广播引起了她的注意。

sentences.en: A woman's body had been found at Jambaroo Lookout, a scenic mountain spot about 40km southwest of Wollongong.
sentences.zh: 在位于卧龙岗西南部约40公里处的一个风景优美的山间观景点詹巴鲁瞭望台（Jambaroo Lookout），发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: What stood out to Donna was the description of the woman's feet.
sentences.zh: 让唐娜感到震惊的是死者脚部的特征描述。

sentences.en: She had a band-aid plastered to each heel.
sentences.zh: 她的每个脚后跟上都贴着创可贴。

sentences.en: Donna hadn't heard from Kim Barry all weekend, which was strange but not necessarily concerning.
sentences.zh: 整个周末唐娜都没有收到金·巴里的消息，这虽然有点奇怪，但并不一定令人担忧。

sentences.en: Upon hearing the radio broadcast, Donna immediately started to worry.
sentences.zh: 听到广播后，唐娜顿时感到忧心忡忡。

sentences.en: She remembered how Kim had stopped to put band-aids on her heels on Friday night.
sentences.zh: 她想起金在周五晚上曾停下来在脚后跟上贴创可贴的事。

sentences.en: Donna decided to call Kim's mother, Beverly, to make sure that Kim was alright.
sentences.zh: 唐娜决定给金的母亲贝弗利打电话，以确认金是否安好。

sentences.en: Upon learning that no one knew where Kim was, Donna quickly shared what she knew.
sentences.zh: 在得知没有人知道金在哪里后，唐娜迅速分享了她所知道的情况。

sentences.en: She mentioned the band-aids and told Beverly about the woman's body found in Jambaroo.
sentences.zh: 她提到了创可贴的事，并将詹巴鲁发现女尸的消息告诉了贝弗利。

sentences.en: But Beverly reassured Donna that the deceased woman couldn't be Kim.
sentences.zh: 但贝弗利安慰唐娜说，死者不可能是金。

sentences.en: Beverly had read a local news article about the same discovery and it reported that the deceased woman found was visibly pregnant.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利读过一篇关于同一发现的当地新闻报道，上面说发现的死者有着明显的孕相。

sentences.en: Kim wasn't pregnant.
sentences.zh: 金并没有怀孕。

sentences.en: Scott Davies was a 19-year-old apprentice plumber who had driven out to visit France on Sunday, February 8, 1981.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·戴维斯（Scott Davies）是一名19岁的管道工学徒，他于1981年2月8日星期日开车去拜访法国人。

sentences.en: As he wound his way around Jambaroo Mountain, he decided to make an impromptu turn-off in search of car parts.
sentences.zh: 当他蜿蜒盘旋在詹巴鲁山上时，他决定临时拐个弯去寻找汽车零件。

sentences.en: Nearby the Jambaroo Lookout was a spot where thieves often dumped cars they had stolen.
sentences.zh: 詹巴鲁瞭望台附近有一个小偷经常倾倒被盗车辆的地方。

sentences.en: The vehicles were typically taken by teenage joyriders who stripped them for parts before leaving them in what was known as the car graveyard.
sentences.zh: 这些车辆通常是被青少年偷来兜风的，他们把零件拆光后，就把车丢弃在被称为汽车墓地的地方。

sentences.en: Scott Davies was aware of the dumping ground and decided to see if he could recover anything he might be able to use to upgrade his old Holden sedan.
sentences.zh: 斯科特·戴维斯知道这个倾倒场，决定去看看能不能找到什么他可以用来升级他的老款霍顿（Holden）轿车的零部件。

sentences.en: Scott made his way to the lookout on foot and peered over the cliff edge.
sentences.zh: 斯科特步行前往瞭望台，探头向下朝悬崖边缘望去。

sentences.en: He could see a few rusted cars about 50 metres below.
sentences.zh: 他可以看到下方约50米处有几辆生锈的汽车。

sentences.en: As he debated the best route to get to the vehicles, Scott's eyes were drawn to a nearby tree.
sentences.zh: 正当他琢磨着通往车辆的最佳路线时，斯科特的视线被附近的一棵树吸引住了。

sentences.en: Beneath was what looked like a naked mannequin.
sentences.zh: 树下躺着一个看起来像裸体人体模特的东西。

sentences.en: Realising that the mannequin was actually a woman's corpse, Scott went looking for help and flagged down a park ranger.
sentences.zh: 意识到那个人体模特其实是一具女尸后，斯科特赶忙去找人帮忙，并拦下了一名公园巡护员。

sentences.en: Soon, police officers arrived at the scene.
sentences.zh: 不久，警员们抵达了现场。

sentences.en: A sling was set up so they could be lowered down from the cliff edge to the spot where the body lay.
sentences.zh: 他们架设起一条吊索，以便从悬崖边缘降落到尸体所在的位置。

sentences.en: Upon closer inspection, officers made the shocking discovery that the woman's head was missing.
sentences.zh: 经过仔细检查，警员们震惊地发现，这名女性的头部不见了。

sentences.en: It had been cleanly cut off from her neck with a sharp instrument.
sentences.zh: 她的头部是用锐器从脖子处干净利落地切下来的。

sentences.en: The cut wasn't surgical or expert, but it had been made carefully post-mortem.
sentences.zh: 这种切割并非外科手术般专业，但却是在死后小心翼翼地完成的。

sentences.en: The woman's fingers were also missing, having been cut off at the first knuckle, likely with a hacksaw and also after her death.
sentences.zh: 死者的手指也不见了，在第一指节处被切除，很可能是用钢锯割断的，同样是在她死后进行的。

sentences.en: A thin, white nylon cord was tied around her right wrists and both ankles.
sentences.zh: 她的右手腕和两个脚踝上都系着一根细细的白色尼龙绳。

sentences.en: Her blouse and bra were wrapped around both her arMs.
sentences.zh: 她的衬衫和胸罩缠绕在双臂上。

sentences.en: The woman appeared to be pregnant, a key detail that was printed in one early article published in the Illawarra Mercury newspaper.
sentences.zh: 死者看起来似乎怀有身孕，伊拉瓦拉水星报（Illawarra Mercury）早期发表的一篇文章中印刷了这一关键细节。

sentences.en: By Monday, February 9, Kim Barry had been missing for three days.
sentences.zh: 到2月9日星期一，金·巴里已经失踪三天了。

sentences.en: Beverly Barry arrived home that evening to find the place empty.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利·巴里那天傍晚回到家，发现屋里空无一人。

sentences.en: She switched on the television to watch the six o'clock news.
sentences.zh: 她打开电视看六点钟的新闻。

sentences.en: A bulletin was broadcast about the body found at Jamboree Lookout the day before.
sentences.zh: 节目中播报了一条关于前一天在詹巴鲁瞭望台发现尸体的快讯。

sentences.en: Footage showed police combing through the thick brush of the mountain, pausing on a detective standing by some soiled garments that had belonged to the woman.
sentences.zh: 画面显示警察正在山上的茂密灌木丛中搜寻，镜头停在一名侦探身上，他正站在属于死者的一些沾满污渍的衣物旁。

sentences.en: One of the items was a torn, bone-coloured blouse.
sentences.zh: 其中一件物品是一件撕破的米色衬衫。

sentences.en: The other was a bra with a green floral emblem in the middle.
sentences.zh: 另一件是中间带有绿色花卉标志的胸罩。

sentences.en: Beverly felt frozen with shock as a newsreader described the clothing.
sentences.zh: 当新闻主播描述这些衣物时，贝弗利惊呆得像被冻僵了一样。

sentences.en: They perfectly matched items that Kim owned.
sentences.zh: 这些衣物与金拥有的物品完全吻合。

sentences.en: Beverly raced to Kim's room and turned it upside down looking for the clothing.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利冲进金的房间，把房间翻了个底朝天来寻找这些衣服。

sentences.en: Then she checked the laundry.
sentences.zh: 接着她检查了洗衣房。

sentences.en: There was no sign of either the blouse or the bra that matched the ones shown on the television.
sentences.zh: 没有发现任何与电视上显示的衬衫或胸罩相匹配的痕迹。

sentences.en: Beverly struggled to breathe and began to cry as she felt a sense of total certainty that the woman found at Jamboree Lookout was her daughter.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利呼吸困难，放声大哭，她感到一种绝对的笃定，那就是在詹巴鲁瞭望台发现的女性正是她的女儿。

sentences.en: When Brian arrived home, Beverly explained the situation and the couple rushed to Wollongong Police Station.
sentences.zh: 当布莱恩回到家时，贝弗利向他说明了情况，夫妻俩随即匆忙赶往卧龙岗警察局。

sentences.en: There, they sat down with detectives and held hands as they described their missing daughter.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们与侦探们坐在一起，手拉着手描述他们失踪的女儿。

sentences.en: Kim had a small birthmark just beneath her right breast and some scarring on her thighs from some bad sandfly bites she'd received five years earlier.
sentences.zh: 金的右胸下方有一个小胎记，大腿上有一些疤痕，那是五年前被毒蝇叮咬造成的。

sentences.en: The detectives listened carefully.
sentences.zh: 侦探们仔细地听着。

sentences.en: The woman they had found had band-aids on both her heels, like Kim.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的那名女性两个脚后跟上也贴着创可贴，就像金一样。

sentences.en: Beneath her right breast was a small birthmark that resembled a mole.
sentences.zh: 她的右胸下方有一个类似于黑痣的小胎记。

sentences.en: There was also faint scarring on both her inner thighs.
sentences.zh: 她的双侧大腿内侧也有淡淡的疤痕。

sentences.en: Taking particular note of these identifying features that the Barrys had described, one of the detectives asked if the couple could look at some clothing found with the body.
sentences.zh: 其中一名侦探特别留意了巴里夫妇所描述的这些特征，询问夫妻俩是否可以看一看在尸体旁找到的一些衣物。

sentences.en: He pulled out an evidence envelope and carefully removed the blouse and bra from inside.
sentences.zh: 他掏出一个物证袋，小心翼翼地从里面拿出了衬衫和胸罩。

sentences.en: Both were immediately recognisable to Brian and Beverly, who'd seen them hanging on the washing line many times.
sentences.zh: 布莱恩和贝弗利一眼就认出了这两样东西，他们曾多次看到它们挂在晾衣绳上。

sentences.en: After checking the size and brand of the blouse, all Beverly could say was,
sentences.zh: 在检查了衬衫的尺码和品牌后，贝弗利所能说的只有：

sentences.en: Yes, that's Kim's.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是金的衣服。

sentences.en: Exposure and decomposition had caused Kim's body to bloat, giving her the appearance of being pregnant.
sentences.zh: 暴露在野外和尸体腐烂导致金的遗体肿胀，使其看起来像是怀了孕。

sentences.en: But testing would confirm that she wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但检测会证实她并不是。

sentences.en: Somehow, the mistaken assumption was printed in initial press reports.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，最初的媒体报道中印出了这个错误的推测。

sentences.en: Photographs of the scene were taken, along with swabs of blood and other bodily fluids.
sentences.zh: 现场拍摄了照片，并提取了血迹和其他体液的拭子。

sentences.en: Kim's body was wrapped in a blanket, then placed on a stretcher and hoisted from the area.
sentences.zh: 金的遗体被裹在毯子里，随后放在担架上，从该地区吊离。

sentences.en: On closer examination, it appeared that Kim had been moved several times after she died, as her remains showed no lividity.
sentences.zh: 经过仔细检查，金在死后似乎被移动过多次，因为她的遗体没有出现尸斑。

sentences.en: Her right forearm was fractured, which had likely occurred when her body was thrown off the cliff.
sentences.zh: 她的右前臂骨折，这很可能是她的遗体被扔下悬崖时造成的。

sentences.en: There was bruising on Kim's left shoulder and cheSt.
sentences.zh: 金的左肩和胸部有瘀伤。

sentences.en: No evidence was found of a sexual assault, nor could a cause of death be established.
sentences.zh: 没有发现性侵的证据，也无法确定死因。

sentences.en: The removal of Kim's head and fingers led to early speculation that the murder was related to organized crime.
sentences.zh: 金的头部和手指被切除，这引发了早期的猜测，即这起谋杀与有组织犯罪有关。

sentences.en: Gang members were known to remove these body parts to prevent a victim being identified by their face, dental records, or fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，帮派成员会切除这些身体部位，以防止受害者通过脸部、牙齿记录或指纹被认出。

sentences.en: Until Kim was identified, the leading theory was that the unknown woman was an informer who'd gotten into trouble with the drug dealers.
sentences.zh: 在金被确认身份之前，主要的推论是，这名身份不明的女子是一名与毒贩发生冲突的线人。

sentences.en: But this theory fell apart after the Barrys came forward.
sentences.zh: 但在巴里夫妇出面后，这个推论不攻自破。

sentences.en: There was no evidence at all that their daughter Kim had any involvement or history with illicit drugs.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据表明他们的女儿金与违禁药物有任何牵连或历史。

sentences.en: After positively identifying the blouse and bra that had been found with Kim's body,
sentences.zh: 在确认了在金的遗体旁找到的上衣和胸罩无误后，

sentences.en: Brian Barry was asked to identify her remains.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩·巴里被要求辨认她的遗体。

sentences.en: He did so by checking the birthmark on her abdomen.
sentences.zh: 他是通过检查她腹部的胎记来确认的。

sentences.en: This identification was also confirmed by matching
sentences.zh: 这一身份确认也通过比对得到了证实，

sentences.en: Kim's palm print to one found in her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 即金的掌纹与她卧室里发现的一枚掌纹相符。

sentences.en: The Barry family were devastated by their loss.
sentences.zh: 巴里一家对痛失亲人悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Kind and nurturing, Kim had dreamt of helping others by becoming a nurse.
sentences.zh: 金善良而富有同情心，她曾梦想成为一名护士来帮助他人。

sentences.en: She'd studied to work as a nursing assistant and had received high marks, but failed the entrance exam due to nerves.
sentences.zh: 她曾学习做护士助理，并且成绩优异，但由于紧张，入学考试没能通过。

sentences.en: Kim had resolved to try again, but took a break by working at a supermarket in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 金决定再试一次，但在此期间她在一家超市工作以作缓冲。

sentences.en: She also volunteered at a residence for disabled children so she could spend time caring for others in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 她还在一个残疾儿童收容所做志愿者，以便能以某种身份花时间照顾他人。

sentences.en: Brian Barry tried to remain stoic to support his wife and son, but he struggled with rage in the wake of his daughter's murder.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩·巴里为了支持妻子和儿子，努力保持坚忍，但在女儿遇害后，他也一直在与心中的愤怒作斗争。

sentences.en: Beverly and Wayne cried together over the loss of Kim.
sentences.zh: 贝弗利和韦恩为失去金而抱头痛哭。

sentences.en: Another family member Kim had been especially close to was her grandfather, known as Pop.
sentences.zh: 金特别亲近的另一个家庭成员是她的祖父，被称为“波普”。

sentences.en: He lived in a small unit at the back of the family home and the two loved each other's company.
sentences.zh: 他住在家庭住宅后方的一个小套间里，两人非常享受彼此的陪伴。

sentences.en: They would sit and talk together for hours.
sentences.zh: 他们会坐在一起聊上几个小时。

sentences.en: As detailed in the book The Stranger You Know by John Suter Linton, Pop often worried about Kim encountering dangerous men when she was out with friends.
sentences.zh: 正如约翰·苏特·林顿所著的《你所了解的陌生人》一书中所详述的那样，波普经常担心金和朋友外出时会遇到危险的男人。

sentences.en: She would reassure him that she wasn't scared, stating,
sentences.zh: 她会安慰他说自己并不害怕，并说道：

sentences.en: Nothing is going to happen to me.
sentences.zh: 我不会有事的。

sentences.en: The day after Kim's body was found, police officers returned to the scene to search for Kim's missing remains, but nothing was recovered.
sentences.zh: 在发现金的遗体的第二天，警员们重返现场搜寻金失踪的遗体，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Detectives took a detailed statement from Donna Holland, the friend Kim had been with on the night she was murdered.
sentences.zh: 侦探们为唐娜·霍兰德做了详细的笔录，唐娜是金被谋杀当晚和她在一起的朋友。

sentences.en: Donna hadn't noticed any suspicious individuals paying attention to
sentences.zh: 唐娜在分道扬镳时，并没有注意到有什么形迹可疑的人在关注

sentences.en: Kim when they parted ways.
sentences.zh: 金。

sentences.en: Nor could she remember seeing anyone who she recognised as an acquaintance of
sentences.zh: 她也记不起曾见过什么人被她认作是

sentences.en: Kim's.
sentences.zh: 金的熟人。

sentences.en: Before she left, Donna gave Kim some money to buy a bottle of Liebfrauwein, a kind of sweet
sentences.zh: 离开前，唐娜给金一些钱去买一瓶Liebfrauwein，这是一种甜味的

sentences.en: German white wine.
sentences.zh: 德国白葡萄酒。

sentences.en: Donna told investigators that Kim said she'd been scared of a prowler in her neighbourhood, but she'd dismissed Kim's claims as a ploy to have Donna stay with her.
sentences.zh: 唐娜告诉调查人员，金曾说她害怕社区里有潜伏的流浪汉，但她把金的话当成是想让她留下来陪自己的把戏，并没有放在心上。

sentences.en: Detectives looked into the matter, but found nothing suggesting there had been a prowler in the area.
sentences.zh: 侦探们对此事进行了调查，但没有发现任何迹象表明该地区曾出现过流浪汉。

sentences.en: They turned their attention to the Crown Gardens disco, where Kim had last been seen alive.
sentences.zh: 他们将注意力转向了皇冠花园迪斯科舞厅，那是金生前最后一次被人看到的地方。

sentences.en: Friday, February 6 had been a busy night at the club, with an estimated 300 patrons in attendance.
sentences.zh: 2月6日星期五是俱乐部生意兴隆的一晚，据估计有300名顾客光顾。

sentences.en: But bar staff at the venue remembered Kim and confirmed that she'd bought a bottle of Liebfrauwein.
sentences.zh: 但该场所的酒吧员工记得金，并证实她买过一瓶Liebfrauwein。

sentences.en: They kept records of every beverage sold, and that was the only bottle of Liebfrauwein purchased that night.
sentences.zh: 他们对售出的每一种饮料都有记录，那是当晚买的唯一一瓶Liebfrauwein。

sentences.en: The staff weren't able to provide any further information as to who Kim might have met while at the bar.
sentences.zh: 员工们无法提供关于金在酒吧时可能见过什么人的更多信息。

sentences.en: A $50,000 reward was offered for information leading to the arrest of Kim Barry's killer.
sentences.zh: 悬赏5万美元征集线索，以协助逮捕金·巴里的凶手。

sentences.en: Exactly one week after Kim was murdered, investigators dressed up a mannequin in the same blouse and pants she had been wearing and displayed it outside the Crown Gardens disco.
sentences.zh: 就在金被谋杀整整一周后，调查人员给一个人体模特穿上了她遇害时穿的同款上衣和裤子，并将其展示在皇冠花园迪斯科舞厅外面。

sentences.en: A wig similar to Kim's wavy dark hair was put on its head, and a photograph of her face was stuck to the mannequin's face.
sentences.zh: 模特的头上戴着一顶类似于金那一头波浪黑发的假发，脸上贴着她面部的照片。

sentences.en: Pinned up next to the mannequin was a sign that read,
sentences.zh: 模特旁边挂着一块牌子，上面写着：

sentences.en: Did you see this girl last Friday night?
sentences.zh: 你上周五晚上见过这个女孩吗？

sentences.en: A caravan that had been converted into a mobile police station was parked in a laneway by the nightclub, and detectives milled about inside the club where patrons could see them.
sentences.zh: 一辆改装成移动警察局的房车停在夜总会旁的小巷里，侦探们在俱乐部内部四处走动，顾客们都能看到他们。

sentences.en: One by one, nightclubbers started approaching the investigators with possible leads about Kim.
sentences.zh: 夜总会的顾客们开始一个接一个地走近调查人员，提供关于金的可能线索。

sentences.en: The detectives would direct them to the mobile station to provide a formal statement.
sentences.zh: 侦探们会指引他们前往移动警局提供正式笔录。

sentences.en: Two sisters came forward to say they'd been at the disco on the night in question.
sentences.zh: 两名姐妹出面说，她们在出事的那个晚上去过迪斯科舞厅。

sentences.en: They'd had a few drinks with a friend named Glenn Potter who was celebrating his birthday.
sentences.zh: 她们和一位名叫格伦·波特的庆祝生日的朋友喝了几杯酒。

sentences.en: Glenn's older brother Graham was also there that night for his Bucks night as he was getting married one week later on Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 格伦的哥哥格雷厄姆当晚也在那庆祝他的单身汉之夜，因为他将在随后的情人节一周后结婚。

sentences.en: The two brothers had combined their respective special occasions into one celebration.
sentences.zh: 兄弟俩将各自的特殊日子合并成了一场庆祝活动。

sentences.en: The sisters had noticed Graham sitting on a couch with a girl.
sentences.zh: 这两姐妹注意到格雷厄姆和一个女孩坐在一张沙发上。

sentences.en: At about 12.30am, Graham walked up to the table where they were seated and said he was leaving but would be back soon.
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨12点半，格雷厄姆走到她们坐的桌子旁，说他要离开一会儿，但很快就会回来。

sentences.en: He handed over his cardigan for safe keeping and set a near empty bottle of wine on the table as he did so.
sentences.zh: 他把开襟羊毛衫交出来让人代为保管，同时在桌上放下了一瓶快见底的酒。

sentences.en: When the detectives asked the sisters if they knew what kind of wine it was, they both replied, Liebfrau Wein.
sentences.zh: 当侦探问这对姐妹知不知道那是什么酒时，她们异口同声地回答：Liebfrau Wein。

sentences.en: When detectives checked to see if Graham Potter had a criminal record, they discovered two previous convictions of break, enter and steal dating back to 1976.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们查阅格雷厄姆·波特是否有犯罪前科时，他们发现了他可以追溯到1976年的两次入室盗窃定罪记录。

sentences.en: Potter had been 18 at the time and was fined $250.
sentences.zh: 波特当时18岁，被罚款250美元。

sentences.en: He also received a three-year good behaviour bond.
sentences.zh: 他还被判处三年的行为良好保证令。

sentences.en: Now aged 23 years old, Potter was employed as a coal miner.
sentences.zh: 现年23岁的波特是一名煤矿工人。

sentences.en: Sifting through other witness statements collected from Crown Garden's patrons, detectives found further evidence that Kim Barry had been seen in Graham Potter's company.
sentences.zh: 在梳理从皇冠花园顾客那里收集到的其他证词时，侦探们找到了更多的证据，证明金·巴里曾与格雷厄姆·波特在一起。

sentences.en: One person saw them sitting on a lounge talking together.
sentences.zh: 有人看到他们坐在一处休息区聊天。

sentences.en: Another spotted them dancing and holding hands.
sentences.zh: 另一个人发现他们在跳舞并手牵着手。

sentences.en: Some time after midnight, the pair were seen walking hand in hand towards the exit.
sentences.zh: 午夜过后不久，有人看到两人手拉着手朝出口走去。

sentences.en: It turned out that Kim had been somewhat acquainted with Potter prior to that night.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，金在当晚之前就对波特略有了解。

sentences.en: The pair had taken dance lessons together at the same school some years earlier.
sentences.zh: 几年前，两人曾在同一所学校一起上过舞蹈课。

sentences.en: Kim had confided in her mother Beverly that she had a bit of a crush on Potter, who was four years older than her.
sentences.zh: 金曾向母亲贝弗利吐露，她对比她大四岁的波特有点好感。

sentences.en: But when Beverly asked Kim about the crush again a few years later,
sentences.zh: 但几年后，当贝弗利再次问起金对他的好感时，

sentences.en: Kim said she no longer liked Potter.
sentences.zh: 金说她不再喜欢波特了。

sentences.en: He thought he was too much of a quote, ladies man.
sentences.zh: 他自认为是个十足的花花公子。

sentences.en: Detectives needed to follow up with Graham Potter in person.
sentences.zh: 侦探们需要当面跟进格雷厄姆·波特的情况。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但有个问题。

sentences.en: A week earlier on Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 一周前的星期二，

sentences.en: February 10, 20-year-old Cherie Jones had been excited about her upcoming wedding.
sentences.zh: 即2005年2月10日，20岁的切丽·琼斯正为即将来临的婚礼感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Cherie was set to marry her fiancé, Graham Potter, in several days' time on Valentine's Day.
sentences.zh: 切丽原本定于几天后的情人节与未婚夫格雷厄姆·波特结婚。

sentences.en: That evening, Cherie and Graham were attending a dance class together to go over the bridal waltz.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，切丽和格雷厄姆一起去上舞蹈课，练习婚礼华尔兹。

sentences.en: Cherie was surprised when Graham unexpectedly cancelled.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆出乎意料地取消了课程，这让切丽感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: He'd called her work that afternoon and left a message saying he couldn't see her but would talk to her later.
sentences.zh: 他在那天下午给她的单位打过电话，留信说他不能见她了，但稍后再和她联系。

sentences.en: Soon, Cherie learned that Potter had also called his younger brother, Glenn, to say he was going away for a little while.
sentences.zh: 很快，切丽得知波特还给他的弟弟格伦打了电话，说他要离开一会儿。

sentences.en: Glenn suspected that his brother had gotten cold feet and cancelled the wedding.
sentences.zh: 格伦怀疑他哥哥临阵退缩并取消了婚礼。

sentences.en: He knew it was Graham's dream to travel around Australia before starting a family.
sentences.zh: 他知道格雷厄姆的梦想是在组建家庭之前环游澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Upon hearing Glenn's news, Cherie was distraught.
sentences.zh: 听到格伦的消息后，切丽心烦意乱。

sentences.en: The truth was, Graham had been acting strangely for days.
sentences.zh: 事实是，格雷厄姆已经反常了好几天。

sentences.en: He'd celebrated his bucks night a few days prior on Friday, February 6, combining it with Glenn's birthday.
sentences.zh: 几天前的2月6日星期五，他庆祝了自己的单身汉之夜，并与格伦的生日合并在一起。

sentences.en: At around one that night, Graham had called
sentences.zh: 那天晚上11点左右，格雷厄姆给

sentences.en: Cherie's parents' home where she lived.
sentences.zh: 切丽居住的父母家打过电话。

sentences.en: He told Cherie he was having fun and had been dancing with a friend.
sentences.zh: 他告诉切丽他玩得很开心，一直在和一个朋友跳舞。

sentences.en: He would come over to her place that night to sleep and asked if she could leave the back door unlocked.
sentences.zh: 他那天晚上会去她那里睡觉，并问她能不能把后门留着别锁。

sentences.en: Cherie did so and left a sleeping bag in the lounge room for Graham.
sentences.zh: 切丽照做了，并在休息室里给格雷厄姆留了一个睡袋。

sentences.en: But when she woke the next morning, the bag was still rolled up and hadn't been slept in.
sentences.zh: 但第二天早上她醒来时，睡袋依然卷着，根本没有人睡过。

sentences.en: Cherie called Graham's unit.
sentences.zh: 切丽给波特的住所打电话。

sentences.en: He answered right away, explaining that he'd decided to go back there with his brother instead.
sentences.zh: 他马上接了电话，解释说他决定和弟弟一起回那里去了。

sentences.en: They'd gotten home at about 2.30am.
sentences.zh: 他们是在凌晨2点半左右到家的。

sentences.en: The couple met up later that day and Cherie noticed that Graham was wearing a ruddy old T-shirt and shorts.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣当天晚些时候碰面了，切丽注意到格雷厄姆穿着一件破旧的旧T恤和短裤。

sentences.en: He typically made an effort to dress well.
sentences.zh: 他平时是很注意穿衣打扮的。

sentences.en: He was also quieter than usual, but discussed their wedding plans happily enough.
sentences.zh: 他也比平时安静，但对他们的婚礼计划讨论得相当开心。

sentences.en: Graham spent most of the weekend with Cherie at her home.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆整个周末都和切丽在她家度过。

sentences.en: On Monday, Graham visited Cherie at home and suddenly blurted out an idea.
sentences.zh: 周一，格雷厄姆到切丽家看望她，并突然脱口说出一个想法。

sentences.en: What if they went travelling together around the country instead of getting married?
sentences.zh: 与其结婚，不如他们一起去全国各地旅游怎么样？

sentences.en: Cherie told him she wanted to marry and settle down first, which led to an argument.
sentences.zh: 切丽告诉他，她想先结婚安定下来，这引发了一场争吵。

sentences.en: Cherie ultimately told Graham that there was no way she would go travelling with him.
sentences.zh: 切丽最终告诉格雷厄姆，她是绝对不可能跟他去旅游的。

sentences.en: The couple made up and later ran some errands together.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣随后重归于好，并一起去办了一些零散差事。

sentences.en: They stopped at a bank and Graham withdrew his entire savings, $2,950.
sentences.zh: 他们在一家银行停下，格雷厄姆取出了他全部的积蓄2950美元。

sentences.en: He told Cherie that he would use the funds to open a joint bank account for them, with some of the money going towards their honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 他告诉切丽，他将用这笔钱为他们开一个联名银行账户，其中一部分钱将用于他们的蜜月。

sentences.en: Then he called his employer and said he was taking the rest of the week off sick.
sentences.zh: 然后他给雇主打电话，说他剩下的几天要请病假。

sentences.en: The last time Cherie had seen her fiancé was at lunchtime on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 切丽最后一次见到她的未婚夫是在周二的午餐时间。

sentences.en: He stopped by her work briefly before later calling to cancel their dance lesson that night.
sentences.zh: 他在她工作的地方匆忙停留了一会儿，随后打电话取消了当晚的舞蹈课。

sentences.en: After asking if they could talk privately, Graham told Cherie,
sentences.zh: 在问他们能否私下谈谈后，格雷厄姆告诉切丽：

sentences.en: don't do anything stupid if anything happens to me.
sentences.zh: 如果我发生什么事，千万别做傻事。

sentences.en: We will get back together again.
sentences.zh: 我们还会重新在一起的。

sentences.en: Later that day,
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，

sentences.en: Graham left in his 1970 White Holden sedan for an unknown destination.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆开着他那辆1970年的白色霍顿轿车驶向未知的目的地。

sentences.en: None of his family or friends had seen him since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他的家人或朋友再也没有见过他。

sentences.en: The day he departed just happened to be the same day that Kim Barry was publicly identified as the headless victim found at Jamboree Mountain Lookout.
sentences.zh: 他出发的那天刚好也是金·巴里被公开确认是在詹布里山观景台发现的无头受害者的同一天。

sentences.en: By the time detectives began to consider Graham Potter a possible suspect on Saturday February 14, they were already aware that he'd skipped town.
sentences.zh: 当侦探们在2月14日星期六开始将格雷厄姆·波特视为可能的嫌疑人时，他们已经知道他畏罪潜逃了。

sentences.en: An early tip they'd received in their investigation had been about a groom who'd
sentences.zh: 他们在调查中收到的早期线索之一，是关于一个新郎在皇冠花园迪斯科舞厅庆祝完单身汉之夜后突然失踪，而那天晚上

sentences.en: abruptly disappeared after celebrating his bucks night at the Crown Gardens disco the same night that
sentences.zh: 金·巴里也恰好在那里。

sentences.en: Kim Barry was there.
sentences.zh: 当时，他们没有其他证据将波特与金联系起来，但他们还是把他的名字列入了潜在嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: At the time, they had nothing else linking Potter to Kim, but they added his name to their list of potential suspects.
sentences.zh: 现在无法对格雷厄姆·波特进行盘问，侦探们转而开始盘问离他最近的人。

sentences.en: Now unable to interview Graham Potter, detectives instead began to question those closest to him.
sentences.zh: 波特的父母似乎对警方为什么要找他们的儿子谈话感到困惑。

sentences.en: Potter's parents seemed confused as to why police would want to speak to their son.
sentences.zh: 他的未婚妻切丽处于震惊状态。

sentences.en: His fiancée Cherie was in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 最有价值的目击证人是波特的弟弟格伦，他曾在皇冠花园迪斯科舞厅和波特在一起。

sentences.en: The most valuable witness was Potter's younger brother, Glenn, who had been with Potter at the Crown Gardens disco.
sentences.zh: 格伦对侦探们态度恶劣，告诉他们他不知道他哥哥在哪里，而且已经好几天没和他说话了。

sentences.en: Glenn was hostile towards the detectives, telling them he had no idea where his brother was and hadn't spoken to him in days.
sentences.zh: 格伦说他们是在午夜左右到达皇冠花园迪斯科舞厅的。

sentences.en: Glenn said they'd arrived at the Crown Gardens disco at around midnight.
sentences.zh: 他看到一个黑发女孩走近他哥哥，两人攀谈起来。

sentences.en: He'd seen a girl with dark hair approach his brother and the pair had struck up a conversation.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个女孩的特征与金·巴里相似，但格伦声称他无法确定是不是她。

sentences.en: Although the girl's features were similar to Kim Barry's, Glenn claimed he couldn't be certain if it was her.
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨12点半，格雷厄姆走到酒吧找格伦，说：我要出去一会儿。

sentences.en: At around 12.30am, Graham approached Glenn at the bar and said, I'm going out for a little while.
sentences.zh: 然后他和那个一直在聊天的女孩一起离开了。

sentences.en: Then he left with the girl he'd been chatting to.
sentences.zh: 一个多小时后，格雷厄姆回来了，格伦问他：进展怎么样？

sentences.en: A little over an hour later, Graham returned and Glenn asked him, how did you go?
sentences.zh: 他指的是格雷厄姆带走的那个女孩，以为他哥哥在结婚前想最后放纵一次。

sentences.en: He was referring to the girl Graham left with, assuming his brother had wanted one last fling before getting married.
sentences.zh: 波特解释说，他把她带回了住所，但她在前门临阵退缩并离开了。

sentences.en: Potter explained that he'd taken her back to his place, but she'd gotten cold feet at the front door and left.
sentences.zh: 波特立刻坐出租车回到了夜总会，甚至还让出租车司机顺路接上了一个他在路上看到的搭便车的海员。

sentences.en: Potter had immediately caught a taxi back to the nightclub and even asked the cab driver to pick up a sailor he'd seen hitchhiking along the way.
sentences.zh: 他看起来一点也不焦虑或担忧。

sentences.en: He didn't seem in any way anxious or concerned.
sentences.zh: 大约凌晨2点45分，兄弟俩离开了迪斯科舞厅，去了格雷厄姆

sentences.en: At about 2.45am, the two brothers had left the disco and gone to Graham
sentences.zh: 波特的家。

sentences.en: Potter's home.
sentences.zh: 在波特家人的允许下，调查人员走访了该套间。

sentences.en: With the Potter family's permission, investigators paid a visit to the unit.
sentences.zh: 里面的财物所剩无几，因为波特的家人担心在他缺席期间住所遭窃，已经把东西拿走代为保管了。

sentences.en: There were few possessions there, as Potter's family had taken them for safekeeping, worried the unit might have been burgled in his absence.
sentences.zh: 住所里一尘不染。

sentences.en: The residence was totally immaculate.
sentences.zh: 肉眼看不到任何迹象表明那里曾发生过什么不寻常的事情。

sentences.en: There was nothing visible to the naked eye that indicated anything untoward had happened there.
